head: bd17b456e079c761013c580ea4263b5c4bc57f5d
scope: Final independent audit of the fr text of the 86 keys PR #1753 added (English additions of 874446c2c80e8c3849c20ed72780d1455e7752a9, derived with git diff 874446c2c8^..874446c2c8 -- src/i18n/catalogues/en): ui.chat.canonical 55, ui.chat.asks 8, ui.chat.sidebar 7, ui.chat.pickers 8, ui.chat.run_details 2, ui.chat.user_turn 3, ui.hub.pages 3. Pre-existing keys were read only as precedent. Confirmed resolved from earlier rounds: fold.receipt.other, fold.count.list_variables, run_details.wake.managed_note. Prior accepted nits n1-n4 are not re-raised.
verified: key list: the 86 added en keys equal 55+8+7+8+2+3+3 and every one exists in fr; the sha256 values below are over the whole committed en/fr namespace files at the head

ICU: all 86 fr messages parse with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (requiresOtherClause); variable names and types equal en for every key; 54 plural messages carry exactly the fr CLDR categories many/one/other (Intl.PluralRules('fr')), no few; every arm still prints the count

plural render at counts 0,1,2,3,5,11,21,22,25,100,1000,1000000,1500000,2000000 via intl-messageformat: 0 and 1 use 'one' ('0 commande shell'), 1000000 and 2000000 use 'many' with de/d' ('1000000 de commandes shell'), 1500000 uses 'other'; no artifact ({ } # undefined NaN) at any count

typography: NFC, no Cf/BOM/ZW characters, no edge or double spaces (fold.unit_separator and fold.sentence.join excepted by design), U+202F before : ; ? and inside « » in every string that has them (withheld, row_label, discard_label, unknown_command_suggest, managed_note, signed_out.body), typographic apostrophe U+2019, no ASCII ' " or ...

literals verbatim: /aida pause, /{command}, {reference}, {path}, {suggestions}, {title}, {name}, {date}, {scope} · {clause}; the sidebar withheld hint quotes the shipped label ui.chat.sidebar.sidebar.search.include_archived 'Inclure les conversations archivées'
safety: Not delivered -> 'Non remis'; answers not yet delivered -> 'pas encore remise(s)' with the can-still-edit fact kept; timed-out -> 'expirée'; nothing pending/failed reads as done

terminology vs shipped fr: job -> tâche (fr guide), wake -> réveil, subagent -> sous-agent, ask -> demande (ui.chat.asks.all_asks, outstanding_count), settled -> réglé(es), outstanding -> en attente (outstanding_aria), chat -> conversation (show_more_chats), steer -> orienter (composer.steer_hint), delivered -> remis (clause.delivering, late_delivery), discard -> abandonner (agents.detail), sign in -> Connectez-vous (agents.upload.sign_in), credential -> identifiant (glossary), Esc/Enter -> Échap/Entrée (picker_host)
register: vous throughout (Lancez, Saisissez, Vouliez-vous, utilisez, Connectez-vous, réessayez); assistant name {name} gets no gendered pronoun
node scripts/i18n/check-coverage.mjs -> 'coverage-check: ok — 7 gated language(s) over 129 namespace(s); 0 allowed key(s) remain'
observations: Not findings: fold.receipt.* uses 'accusé de réception/réveil' while ui.chat.pickers has 'récépissé de commande' and ui.hub 'Reçu d’opération' for other receipts; these name different objects (a delivered system notice vs a command/operation receipt) and the fr guide records no receipt term.

fold.count.search and fold.count.web both read 'recherche' / 'recherche web' because the en pair is 'search' / 'web search'; the context sidecar for count.search describes page fetches, but the fr follows the en word and the pair stays distinguishable.

Display artifact, not a finding: the auditing session's tool output masks the committed string 'Connectez-vous' (ui.hub.pages.signed_out.title and body) as a redaction marker when it starts a displayed segment. The catalogue bytes were checked codepoint by codepoint (U+0043 U+006F U+006E U+006E ... = 'Connectez-vous') and are unaffected; the same imperative is used by shipped fr keys such as ui.agents.upload.sign_in.title_continue.
